name: workflow-skills
description: Multi-agent workflow skills (implementation from notes of the user's words and an approved draft, autonomous implementation, copywriting, visual decisions and visual verification, opening and watching a pull request, recovery of an interrupted run) plus skills with the rules for engineering, code, writing and hygiene, a library of model-neutral review-lens skills and the agents run by each workflow stage, and a rule checker that has a second model check the end of each turn of the main agent against the binding rules.
